Description: This AIM receives the image of a page as a Basic Visual Object and, optionally, a Point on it (OSD-PNT-V1.5), and produces a Text Object: the lines of text found on a band of the page about the Point (at the top of the page with no Point), in the full width of the page, in reading order, each a Basic Text Object with its box on the page and its confidence. The box of a line is the Space-Time of the line in the Text Object: SpatialAttitude1 is its top-left corner, SpatialAttitude2 its bottom-right corner, in the pixels of the image (X to the right, Y down). The confidence of a line is in its Data Exchange Metadata.
